## Approach (the doctor's own emphasis)

His work aims to: **minimise unnecessary surgical interventions** · **prioritise exercise and "movement medicine"** · **support healthy living and national recovery** · and to use **ultrasound-guided regenerative procedures** (PRP, prolotherapy) only where they are expected to change the outcome. One visit: assessment → diagnostic MSK ultrasound → image-guided intervention → return-to-movement plan.

## Services & procedures (by category)

1. **Diagnostic MSK ultrasound** — shoulder, hip, knee, tendon, spine, peripheral nerve imaging and mapping.
2. **Interventional & regenerative** — ultrasound-guided PRP, prolotherapy; corticosteroid & hyaluronic acid injections; radiofrequency denervation; Botox for spasticity.
3. **Spine & pain** — facet, medial branch, SI-joint and trigger-point injections; dry needling; radicular pain pathways.
4. **Shoulder** — frozen shoulder (adhesive capsulysis), rotator-cuff tendinopathy, calcific tendinopathy, impingement, labral pathology.
5. **Hip & periarticular** — snapping hip, hip impingement, labral injury, bursitis, periarticular tendinopathy.
6. **Tendons & sports** — Achilles, patellar, gluteal / ITB tendinopathy, golfer's/tennis elbow, de Quervain, jumpers / throwers elbow.
7. **Foot & ankle** — plantar fasciopathy, peroneal / tibial tendinopathy, tarsal tunnel, metatarsalgia.
8. **Botox & spasticity** — upper-/lower-limb spasticity, dystonia, chronic migraine, hyperhidrosis (selected).
9. **Hand & wrist** — carpal tunnel, cubital tunnel, trigger finger, wrist / hand tendon and nerve pathology.

## Credentials (verified)

MBChB (Al-Anbar, Iraq) · MRCGP (London) · CCT in Physical & Rehabilitation Medicine (UK) · EBPRM · AAPM&R International Certificate (US) · Dip MSK (RCS Edinburgh) · Dip-SOMM / MSOMM (BSMM) · FIFA Diploma in Football Medicine · Clinical Supervisor (Edge Hill, UK) · MSK Ultrasound Fellowship (England) · Dip FSEM / DFSEM · BASEM · DABRM.

## Frequently asked

- Referral: not required for most private consultations; some insurance plans need prior authorisation (hospital handles both).
- Insurance: both clinics work with the main UAE panels.
- PRP: proposed only when expected to change outcome — never a default.
- Injections: ultrasound-guided, local anaesthetic, fine needles; brief discomfort rather than pain in most cases.
- Arabic: fully supported.
